name: Empty State
summary: Passive resolved-absence composition with required title content, optional supporting message and decorative icon, one canonical Button-or-Link action slot, and target-owned lifecycle, heading context, announcements, and replacement.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Ordinary passive grouping root that replaces the otherwise empty content area; it has no intrinsic role, live-region semantics, focus, or interaction.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Optional decorative icon hidden from assistive technology; it reinforces but never supplies the state meaning.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Required non-empty visible title rendered by the host with the contextually correct native h1-h6 element. The CSS class and typography are heading-element agnostic.

anatomy.name: message
anatomy.description: Optional concise supporting explanation or next step, omitted when not supplied.

anatomy.name: action
anatomy.description: One optional canonical Button or Link composition slot. Link navigates; Button performs a command; Empty State owns no local action style or behavior.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Single centered resolved-absence presentation. State classification and copy remain target-owned.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One container-responsive composition with no public size property.

states.name: resolved-empty
states.description: Target has resolved that the surrounding content area has no content to show; this is not a loading state.

behavior.name: resolvedAbsence
behavior.description: The target decides that absence is resolved, classifies no-data versus no-results or other conditions, and supplies truthful concise copy. Empty State does not fetch, filter, diagnose, retry, or infer loading/error state.

behavior.name: contextualHeading
behavior.description: The owning page, panel, dialog, or section supplies the contextually correct native h1-h6 element. Heading rank is not a target-agnostic property or visual Studio control, and the class renders consistently without native heading defaults.

behavior.name: actionComposition
behavior.description: At most one recovery action composes canonical Button or Link. The target owns label, destination or command, events, disabled/loading state, and post-activation focus.

behavior.name: dynamicAnnouncement
behavior.description: Static or initial Empty State has no live role. When a search, filter, removal, or other update creates a qualifying status message, a pre-existing target Status/live region owns the announcement without moving focus or duplicating the visible title.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Logical sizing, container-relative inline padding and emergency wrapping preserve short, long, localized, RTL, narrow-container and zoomed content.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Required non-empty visible content that identifies what is absent. The host supplies the native heading element separately as contextual markup, not as a component property.

properties.name: message
properties.description: Optional concise supporting explanation or next step, omitted rather than rendered empty.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Optional decorative icon that reinforces the visible title. Meaningful illustration alternative text is outside the current contract.

properties.name: action
properties.description: One optional canonical Button or Link composition chosen and controlled by the target.

accessibility: Supply required non-empty title content and render it with the native h1-h6 element appropriate to the owning page, panel, dialog, or section; do not expose rank as visual configuration.
Keep the optional icon decorative and hidden because the visible title carries the meaning; the current contract does not support a meaningful illustration.
Compose one native canonical Link for navigation or Button for a command and preserve that component's keyboard, focus, disabled, loading, and accessible-name behavior.
Do not add Status or Alert to every root. Targets own pre-existing live-region output for dynamic no-results or destructive-update transitions that qualify as status messages.
Do not move focus merely to announce absence, trap focus, or leave stale underlying records and actions exposed beside the replacement.
Do not use Empty State while data is pending; use Skeleton or Spinner, and use Progress for measurable completion.

web.notes: Canonical CSS implements passive container-responsive composition. Target markup owns contextual heading, lifecycle, announcement, focus, and one Button-or-Link action slot.

shopify.notes: Dedicated snippet maps icon, title, message, and Link action and requires a validated target-supplied heading_tag. Main cart and 404 use H1; the cart drawer uses H3 under its H2 dialog title.

react.notes: Framework target owns resolved state, contextual heading markup, announcements, canonical action, and replacement.

figma.notes: Map slot presence and semantic presentation only; heading rank, lifecycle, Status, and action behavior are not visual properties.

swiftui.notes: Native target owns header traits, resolved data state, announcements, focus, and Button/Link action semantics.

compose.notes: Native target owns heading semantics, resolved data state, announcements, focus, and Button/Link action semantics.
